spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous padding, bento grids with slight asymmetry, breathing room to let cake photos shine.

components.header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F5]/80, sticky top-0, z-50
components.buttons: Pill shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses Terracotta (#D36A52) with white text. WhatsApp buttons use #25D366.
components.cards: Subtle #E5DCD3 1px border, shadow-sm, bg-white. Neumorphic soft clay touch.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

hero_background.description: Elegant white cake with gold decorations, perfect for a high-end warm bakery hero section overlay.

gallery.description: Homemade layered chocolate cake slice, looks moist and rich.

about_image.description: Warm, cozy bakery ambiance photo for the 'About Diya' section.

hero.layout: Asymmetrical. Large arch-shaped hero image on right, brand text on left. Background is #FAF8F5.
hero.text: The Cake Cottage By Diya. 100% Eggless & Fresh Homemade Bakery Cakes.

gallery_section.layout: Bento Grid (cols-1 md:cols-2 lg:cols-3). Cards have generous padding.
gallery_section.functionality: Showcase cakes with 'Order Now' WhatsApp deep link pre-filled with the cake name.

about_section.layout: Side-by-side (Image + Text). Use subtle Sage green accent here to highlight '100% Eggless'. Mention 2 years experience.
about_section.content: 2 years of independent experience and 1 year of training experience. Speciality in customised cakes, any type. 100% eggless and fresh homemade bakery cakes. Order one day in advance.

order_form_section.submit_action: Composes a WhatsApp URL and redirects. E.g., https://wa.me/919041615117?text=Hi%20Diya...

location_and_contact.address: Lighta wala chownk, near back side of Preet Dhaba, Mavi Colony, Morinda, Punjab 140101

admin_panel.layout: Simple Dashboard (Archetype 1, but focused on utility). bg-[#FAF8F5].
features: Add/Edit/Delete forms for cakes (Name, Description, Price, Category, Image URL)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend with React, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn/ui in .js and .jsx extensions.
Use Merienda font for headings and Outfit for body text (import via Google Fonts).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. E.g. data-testid='hero-whatsapp-btn'.
Do not use generic placeholder images. Use the exact URLs provided in the media section.
Ensure '100% Eggless' is visually distinct, perhaps using the Accent Sage (#9BABA0) color as a badge.
Admin panel should be functional, use local storage or the FastAPI backend if provided to store and retrieve cake items.
Form must validate required fields before attempting to redirect to WhatsApp.
Ensure the hero section uses soft overlays and generous spacing.
